items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: Yes, I did with George Hartman too. We'd pick up spot jobs here and there.

ctx.x: And others talking about red beans and rye. Right. But I know you worked some dates with Bill Bourgeois.

Yes, I did with George Hartman too. We'd pick up spot jobs here and there. In fact, when I came to this town after all those many years, Bill Bourgeois reminded me that we had played together for a Jewish leader up in New York at a dance celebrating Hitler's birthday. His memory was better than mine though. I'd forgotten it until he mentioned it. And you know, you had a clique and you tried to help each other out with spot jobs. So we'd actually moved around somewhat and meet them off and together on jobs.
How big a band was that playing for the district? Probably eight men.
